stem: By the time the Berlin Wall fell in 1989, it ____ the city for twenty-eight years.

stem: Inflation is the rate ____ the general level of prices rises over time.

stem: ____ the Vikings abandoned their settlement in Newfoundland after a relatively short time remains uncertain.

stem: ____ having almost no natural resources, Singapore became one of the wealthiest countries in Asia.

stem: ____, the quipu allowed Inca officials to keep records of census and tax data.

It was a device made of knotted cords

explanation: An appositive is a noun phrase with no main verb that renames a noun; it can come before the subject: "A device made of knotted cords, the quipu allowed ..." The other options contain a full clause or are ungrammatical.

stem: A government can try to stimulate a weak economy by cutting taxes, increasing public spending, and ____.

stem: The more a currency's value falls, ____ imported goods become for consumers.
